notes.title: Magnesia - Early Access update #2
notes.content:
Hello again!

We have another update coming to you with new content, performance fixes and bug fixes!

[h1]New content[/h1]

[b]Prologue[/b]
[list]
[*]  Added a clip of slides explaining the storyline (it is skipable with spacebar)
[/list]

[b]All chapters and main screen[/b]
[list]
[*] Added V-sync in the Options menu
[*] Added activity camera - Your camera will switch to the area that changed
[*] More lighting
[*] Added more textures
[*] Added the bad guy into the game instead of Toruko Games video placeholder
[*] Removed the auto spinning when activate a magnet. It is mechanic that we struggled with to remove because we wanted to let the people experience a feeling of confusion.
[*] Added music from our sound producer
[*] Updated sound effects
[*] Updated Main Menu
[*] Updated Chapter selection
[*] Updated loading screen
[/list]

[b]Chapter 1[/b]
[list]
[*]  The spawn area serves as a tutorial of the various mechanics in the game
[*]  Added  bad guy video after you pick up the attractor
[*] All exits in last area are now sealed when attractor is picked up. Making it easier to figure out where to go. 
[/list]

[b]Chapter 2[/b]
[list]
[*]  Added another roomba bot to make this chapter faster. No more waiting for the one robot to come back around.
[*] Added bad guy after picking up second attractor
[/list]

[b]Chapter 4[/b]
[list]
[*]  Added this new chapter. Check it out!
[/list]


[h1]Fixes[/h1]

[list]
[*] Fixed bugs that were posted by the community
[*] Fixed gameplay input of video's posted by the community
[/list]

notes.title: Magnesia - Early access update #1
notes.content:
Hello!

We have another update coming to you with new content, performance fixes and bug fixes!

[h1]New content[/h1]

[b]Chapter 1[/b]
[list]
[*]  New spawn area - You spawn inside a smelter room, ready to be turned into scrap. You have to escape!
[*]   Changed the overall look of the magnet room.
[/list]

[b]Chapter 2[/b]
[list]
[*]  Changed the look and mechanics of the first encountered puzzle
[*]  Added more couches and plants to make you feel more at home!
[*] Changed the mechanics of the third puzzle in the blue magnet room. You can no longer push the file cabinet to the side! 
[/list]

[b]Chapter 3[/b]
[list]
[*]  Added this whole new chapter! Check it out!
[*]  I am not gonna spoil anything... Seriously, check it out :)
[/list]

[h1]Fixes[/h1]

[list]
[*] Fixed spawn area that was rendering too many batches
[*] Fixed overall FPS drops by reducing the amount of lighting and batches
[*] Fixed bugs that were posted by the community
[/list]

notes.title: Early access release
notes.content:
Thank you for checking out our page and game. Please keep in mind that we are working very hard on resolving issues and any feedback that you can give us. All of us are closely involved with the development process. 

If you encounter any bugs, please leave a comment and we will try to find a fix for this issue. One of our developers will reply as soon as possible.
